Description: Play Perfect is a fast-growing mobile gaming company that provides entertainment to millions of users around the world. The company is headquartered in Tel Aviv. • With a team of talented and passionate developers, designers, industry experts and gamers, Play Perfect is at the forefront of creating immersive gaming experiences that engage players on a whole new level. • As we continue to push the boundaries of what is possible in gaming, Play Perfect is poised to shape the future of the industry and redefine what it means to be a skill-based gaming company. • As we expand, we're looking for a hands-on Data Scientist to own research, experimentation, and simulation. You’ll independently drive projects from business question to product recommendation, combining strong statistical skills, creative thinking, and fast execution. Working closely with Product, Development, Game Economy, and BI, you’ll help shape game mechanics and improve player and business outcomes. • Responsibilities: • ﻿ Own data science projects end to end, from defining business questions and success criteria to building, deploying, and maintaining solutions that deliver actionable insights and business impact. • Analyze and optimize game economies, balancing player experience, engagement, and business performance. • Design and evaluate reward systems, personalization mechanisms, and game features using statistical modeling and simulations. • Lead A/B testing initiatives, including experiment design, analysis, and interpretation of results, and develop reliable experimentation tools. • Apply statistical and causal inference methods to understand player behavior, evaluate product changes, and support decision-making. • Develop and maintain AI-powered tools and solutions to improve business processes and team efficiency. • Communicate findings clearly to technical and business stakeholders, document methods and decisions, and collaborate with cross-functional • Requirements: • 3+ years of experience in Data Science, Applied Statistics, or a similar analytical role. • B.Sc. or higher in Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, or a related quantitative field. • Strong statistical foundation, including experimental design, hypothesis testing, and A/B testing. • Experience with simulations, probabilistic modeling, and data-driven decision-making. • Strong Python and SQL skills for data analysis, modeling, and development. • Ability to independently lead projects end to end, with strong problem-solving and communication skills. • Experience with causal inference, machine learning, or game economy – an advantage. • Experience building AI agents or deploying analytical applications – an advantage. •

What you’ll need

  • 3+ years of experience in Data Science, Applied Statistics, or a similar analytical role
  • B.Sc. or higher in Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, or a related quantitative field
  • Strong statistical foundation, including experimental design, hypothesis testing, and A/B testing
  • Experience with simulations, probabilistic modeling, and data-driven decision-making
  • Strong Python and SQL skills for data analysis, modeling, and development
  • Ability to independently lead projects end to end, with strong problem-solving and communication skills
  • Experience with causal inference, machine learning, or game economy plus
  • Experience building AI agents or deploying analytical applications plus

Description: Fetcherr builds responsible AI that transforms market complexity into measurable profit growth. • At the core of the company is the Market Model - a proprietary AI-powered model delivering accurate, granular demand predictions with 96% forecast accuracy and real-time decision intelligence for commercial teams. Built on a glass-box architecture, it uses market data - not personal data - with full transparency into logic and outcomes. First deployed in global aviation, the technology is industry-agnostic and scales across volatile markets. • Fetcherr delivers a consistent average profit uplift of 7%, with corporate partners including Delta, Virgin Atlantic, WestJet, Viva, and Azul. • We’re looking for a Data Analyst with expertise in Tableau to join our growing data analytics team. This role is perfect for someone who thrives on turning data into actionable insights and enjoys working at the intersection of business and technology. • At Fetcherr, the Insights & Decision Science (IDS) team is where data meets storytelling. We take the hard work of our AI pricing engine and translate it into something airlines can actually see, trust, and act on — think rigorous statistical analysis with a human touch. If a number moves, we explain why. If a client has a question, we have the answer (and the chart to back it up). • Requirements: • You have excellent communication and storytelling skills to transform complex datasets into meaningful insights for non-technical audiences. • You have at least 2 years of experience in Tableau(Must), including building reports, creating dashboards, and working with Tableau Prep and overall at least 4 years of experience in data analytics • You’re a team player, ready to support others and ensure deadlines are met. • You are proficient in SQL (BigQuery and Dataform experience is a plus) and have experience working with ETL processes, integrating data from multiple sources. • You are confident working with large-scale datasets and understand how to optimize query logic, indexes, and joins for performance. • You possess strong analytical skills and can break down ambiguous problems into actionable solutions. • You hold a B.Sc. or Master’s degree in Economy, Statistics, Mathematics, or a related field. • You have experience with Tableau Server administration (e.g., user management, performance monitoring, and troubleshooting). • You are eager to continuously learn and adapt to new challenges. • Nice to have: • Experience with Python libraries such as pandas, numpy, matplotlib, or plotly. • Domain knowledge in following industries: airlines, transportation, logistics or vacations •

What you’ll need

  • You have at least 2 years of experience in Tableau(Must), including building reports, creating dashboards, and working with Tableau Prep and overall at least 4 years of experience in data analytics
  • You’re a team player, ready to support others and ensure deadlines are met
  • You are proficient in SQL (BigQuery and Dataform experience is a plus) and have experience working with ETL processes, integrating data from multiple sources
  • You possess strong analytical skills and can break down ambiguous problems into actionable solutions
  • You hold a B.Sc. or Master’s degree in Economy, Statistics, Mathematics, or a related field
  • You have experience with Tableau Server administration (e.g., user management, performance monitoring, and troubleshooting)
  • You are eager to continuously learn and adapt to new challenges
  • Experience with Python libraries such as pandas, numpy, matplotlib, or plotly plus
  • Domain knowledge in following industries: airlines, transportation, logistics or vacations plus

Description: Come and join a rapidly expanding mobile games company! • Who are we?: SuperPlay is a leading gaming company dedicated to creating unforgettable mobile gaming experiences. Founded in 2019 by industry experts from Playtika and Rovio, the company strives to develop innovative and exciting casual games that captivate millions of players worldwide and remain enjoyable for years to come. • Dice Dreams, our flagship game, has become a global sensation and a top-100-grossing hit, while Domino Dreams, our next big success, is also making a significant impact in the industry. • Our Newest Game – A Magical Collaboration with Disney! • Released in 2025, Disney Solitaire brings beloved Disney stories and characters to life in an unforgettable gaming experience. • Our team, headquartered in Tel Aviv, is made up of talented, passionate, and ambitious professionals. And the future is even more exciting! Want to be part of our journey? Check out the job description below. • What will you do at SuperPlay?: We have petabytes of data, but data isn't insight. Your mission is to be the bridge between raw information and strategic action. This isn't about being a "dashboard provider" - you will be measured by the quality of insights you generate; it's about creating "aha!" moments by going beyond the "what" to uncover the "why" that drives player behavior and shapes our success. • This role is unique: our data is exceptionally clean. There is no ETL or technical pipeline maintenance. Our time is almost exclusively spent on thinking, brainstorming, learning, and researching. • In this role, you will: • Be a strategic partner to our product, design, and leadership teams. Your job is to bring them not just answers, but better questions. You'll translate your findings into compelling, actionable recommendations that catalyze new features, better experiences, and smarter business decisions. • Hypothesize, test, and build frameworks to understand how virtual economies thrive and how player incentives drive long-term engagement. • Embark on deep research projects to deconstruct our most complex business questions. Your deliverable will be a compelling narrative, backed by rigorous analysis, that guides our strategic business roadmap. • Focus on what’s important. We use modern tools (like LLMs) for brainstorming and automating the mundane. Your focus will be on the ambiguous, the complex, and the truly innovative. • Who are you?: Our definition of a good analyst is simple: someone who provides decision-makers with interesting insights. • There are varied archetypes and backgrounds that fit this definition, but some core traits are universal: • 2+ years of experience in the gaming industry/ more than 3 years of experience in Monetization. • You are a first-principles thinker with an innate need to break down complex problems to their fundamental truths. • You possess a deep-seated curiosity to understand human behavior. • You develop strong, data-informed opinions and aren't afraid to voice them. However, you are eager to be challenged and ready to be convinced by new evidence or a better argument. • You can effortlessly translate a complex statistical model into a clear, persuasive story for any audience, with an emphasis on C-level executives. • You are resourceful and self-driven, comfortable navigating uncertainty and motivated to find a path forward even when the way isn't clear • You get bonus points for:: The journey from a complex question to a clear insight is often accelerated by the right tools. Experience with the following is useful for this role (though not required): • A solid understanding of experimental design and A/B testing methodologies. • Proficiency in querying and manipulating large datasets (e.g., strong SQL skills). • Experience using a scripting language like Python for data analysis and automation. • Familiarity with user analytics platforms (e.g., Mixpanel). • Experience with data visualization tools (e.g., Looker). •

Role Overview The Associate Director, Real-World Data & Evidence Foundations makes licensed real-world data fit for the studies and insights that depend on it. Claims, electronic health records are collected for care and billing, not for research. Each source brings its own challenges for new applications: gaps in enrollment, delayed resolution of claims, shifts between diagnosis coding versions. This person owns the path from a new data delivery to curated, documented, analysis-ready data a scientist can trust, and knows which of those problems matters for which question. They work on data platforms that IT and the enterprise platform teams own and run and bring the real-world data expertise those platforms need. Agentic AI coding tools are part of how they work every day. Key Responsibilities Real-World Data Curation Assess each licensed claims, EHR and registry source for fitness for purpose before it is used: what it captures, and which questions it can and cannot answer. Build and run the ingestion and curation pipelines that turn each delivery into analysis-ready data, handling enrollment and eligibility periods, claims lag and adjudication, and changes between coding-system versions. Keep intact the details that change results, such as the decimal in an ICD-10 code, and document every transformation so a reviewer can trace any result back to the source files. Map sources to common data models such as OMOP where reuse justifies it, and maintain the code lists, phenotype definitions and linkage rules that studies share. Build standard cohorts and variables , with lookback and washout windows defined, so recurring questions do not start from raw data. Check data quality and automated conformance, completeness and plausibility checks to inform each source’s fitness-for-purpose assessment. Work with the platform teams on how each source is loaded, stored and refreshed, so a new data cut does not mean weeks of rework and routine cohort queries come back quickly. Apply the terms of each data license and data use agreement, including access controls, small-cell suppression and output checks. Agentic AI Use agentic coding tools such as Claude Code routinely to write and test curation code, and maintain responsibility to review for quality and accuracy. Work within company AI governance, and keep patient-level and licensed data out of any tool not approved for it. Scientific & Strategic Leadership Lead the design of standardized workflows which support complex non-interventional real-world studies and analytical strategies. Strong understanding on how to frame research questions and define fit-for-purpose real-world evidence approaches. Contribute standardized workflows for evidence strategies that support development, regulatory and broader product lifecycle decisions. Anticipate methodological and data risks and propose practical solutions. Decision Enablement Translate repeatable analyses into clear, actionable insights for decision-making using standardized approaches. Support portfolio-level decisions on evidence generation, data selection and analytical strategy. Help ensure standardized evidence approaches are relevant to the questions being asked and the decisions they’re meant to support. Cross-Functional Collaboration Collaborate across clinical development, biostatistics, regulatory, medical, HEOR, data science and IT. Work with IT and the enterprise data and platform teams, who own the shared infrastructure, so curation work fits company architecture and security standards. Build trusted working relationships that make execution and alignment easier. Minimum Qualifications PhD, or a Master’s degree with equivalent experience, in epidemiology, biostatistics, statistics, data science, computer science or a related quantitative field. 8+ years in real-world data or real-world evidence, including hands-on work preparing claims, EHR or registry data for research use. Working command of the coding systems these sources use, such as ICD, CPT, NDC, ATC and LOINC, and of mapping between them. Knowledge of how the way real-world data is collected shapes confounding, missingness and misclassification, and what that means for curation choices. Solid grounding in observational study design and causal inference. Strong Python and SQL, written with software engineering habits such as Git and automated testing. Enough R to work alongside analysts who use it. Regular hands-on use of agentic AI coding tools such as Claude Code on real projects, with the testing and review habits that keep the output trustworthy. Clear communication of data choices and their consequences to scientists and decision makers. Preferred Qualifications OMOP CDM and OHDSI tools. Experience with Israeli health data sources. Linking or tokenizing patient records across real-world data sources. Working on cloud data platforms with query performance in mind. Computerized system validation (GxP) or other regulated data practice. A publication record or open-source contributions in real-world data methods or tooling. We believe that this variety drives excellence and innovation, strengthening our ability to lead in science and technology. We are committed to creating access and opportunities for all to develop and grow at your own pace. Join us in building a culture of inclusion and belonging that impacts millions and empowers everyone to work their magic and champion human progress! Apply now and become a part of a team that is dedicated to Sparking Discovery and Elevating Humanity!

Experience level: Senior. Description: About the role • PDQ runs A/B tests in our merchants’ checkouts. You own experimentation and product analytics, and every result you report must hold up when someone challenges it. • You lead without a team. You pick the problems, ship the work yourself, and set the bar for the analysts around you. • You think AI-first, and you build. When an analysis repeats, you turn it into a skill in MAXX, our AI analyst agent. When a team still works by hand, you automate it. You shape how PDQ uses AI, in the product and across the company. Nobody assigns you this part of the job. You take it. • What you’ll own • Experimentation. Test design, sizing and readouts for all merchants, and a repository of what we learn from wins and losses. • AI in analytics. New MAXX skills, and automation of the analysis work teams still do by hand. • Product analytics. How PDQ measures adoption, activation and impact, and the definitions behind them. • A CRO framework for 200+ active merchants. Segmentation, opportunity scoring and expected impact that MAXX and CSMs run per merchant. • Churn and expansion. The loop from churn signal to intervention to outcome, and a per-merchant ROI scorecard for Sales and CS. • SaaS metrics and win/loss. MRR, NRR and LTV, the monthly close with Finance, and a quarterly readout on why we win and lose deals. • Requirements: • 6+ years in product or business analytics, in e-commerce or B2B SaaS. If you come from SaaS, you love online shopping. • Hands-on A/B testing (we check it live in the interview): hypothesis, sample size and power, duration, randomization unit, sample ratio mismatch, and segment cuts. You know when a winning segment is noise. • Product thinking. You turn a vague question into a metric, a test, or a clear "we should not measure this". • AI-first builder. You use AI agents every day, and you built something with them that other people use: an agent, a skill, or an automated analysis. You check the output against the data and defend every number without the AI. • Strong SQL and comfort in Python. • You present to a CFO, a Sales VP or a CSM in their language, and when challenged you answer from the data. • Self-driven and curious. You find the question before anyone asks it. • Tel Aviv office four days a week. Full professional English. • Advantages • E-commerce or DTC domain experience, on the product or merchant side. • Hands-on Snowflake experience. • Agentic analytics: semantic models an agent queries, MCP tools, and guardrails that stop an agent from inventing a number. • Good understanding of frequentist and Bayesian experimentation (sequential testing, CUPED, multiple-comparison control). • Churn, LTV or pLTV modeling. • How we hire • We use a home task with data, then a live session where you present it and we challenge it. Use AI the way you normally work. We will ask about the data and your choices, not the slides. •

What you’ll need

  • 6+ years in product or business analytics, in e-commerce or B2B SaaS. If you come from SaaS, you love online shopping
  • Hands-on A/B testing (we check it live in the interview): hypothesis, sample size and power, duration, randomization unit, sample ratio mismatch, and segment cuts. You know when a winning segment is noise
  • Product thinking. You turn a vague question into a metric, a test, or a clear "we should not measure this"
  • Strong SQL and comfort in Python
  • You present to a CFO, a Sales VP or a CSM in their language, and when challenged you answer from the data
  • Self-driven and curious. You find the question before anyone asks it
  • Tel Aviv office four days a week. Full professional English
  • E-commerce or DTC domain experience, on the product or merchant side plus
  • Hands-on Snowflake experience plus
  • Good understanding of frequentist and Bayesian experimentation (sequential testing, CUPED, multiple-comparison control) plus
  • Churn, LTV or pLTV modeling plus
  • How we hire plus

What You’ll Do The Senior Product Analyst is a key player in the Product department and helps drive data-driven decisions across different product domains. The Senior Product Analyst role includes bridging our data science endeavors with operational excellence, guiding the development of ML/AI technologies that power our classification systems querying and analyzing data, evaluating feature alternatives, designing experiments, and planning and creating dashboards. The individual in this role will work directly with Product Managers to support product decision questions and analyses. This role owns the Classification & Brand Safety analytics domain for Open Web — the content ontology, site/page classification pipelines, and brand-safety suitability metrics that underpin our brand safety product suite. It also carries an explicit mandate to grow the team's analytics engineering maturity and to help design the next generation of AI-assisted / agentic analytics workflows that are replacing purely manual, reactive reporting and support. This role is part of a professional Product Analysis group supporting core products serving advertisers and publishers across the digital landscape. The role requires big data analysis, attention to detail, business understanding, and strong product intuition. Communication skills are incredibly important, as the position interfaces across functions and geographies. Job Responsibilities Gathering and analyzing large amounts of information to discover & develop compelling, insightful, data-driven recommendations. Communicating state of business, experiment results, etc. to product, data science and engineering teams. Defining and monitoring key product metrics & system health, conducting root cause analyses. Asking business and product-relevant questions and answering them with data. Gaining a deep understanding of the products and their development processes, determining how to solve everyday issues best, and suggesting new features to solve ongoing issues. Supporting and extending internal AI-driven recommendation systems for brand safety insights ; building the underlying data foundations, decision matrices, and parameterized SQL libraries that power agentic/conversational reporting tools, and helping identify and mitigate failure modes (e.g., hallucinations and AI Slop) in these agentic flows. Building, testing, and maintaining analytics-engineering-grade data pipelines. Leading or supporting high-visibility client escalations and QBRs with the Operations team (e.g., major advertiser recall/precision reviews), translating methodology into clear, defensible findings for external and internal stakeholders. Who You Are BA/BSc degree. 5+ years of experience with quantitative analysis. Extensive hands-on experience with SQL Hands-on experience with Python (for data manipulation), Excellent understanding of statistics (e.g., hypothesis testing, regression types). Hands-on experience with, or strong motivation to develop, analytics engineering skills — building and maintaining DBT models (or equivalent), including staging/intermediate/mart layering, tests, and documentation. Capable of working simultaneously on multiple tasks. Comfort working with large-scale cloud data warehouses (Databricks, BigQuery, Snowflake) and BI/semantic layers (Looker/LookML). Working familiarity with AI/LLM-assisted analytics workflows — e.g., using AI coding assistants (Claude Code, Cursor) for query and pipeline development, and a basic understanding of the difference between deterministic metric logic and probabilistic agentic systems, including their failure modes (hallucinations, prompt drift etc.) Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English. Preferred Qualifications BA/BSc in a quantitative field: Statistics / Mathematics/ Economics /Computer Science, Physics/ Biology/ Psychology/ Chemistry/ Engineering, or other technical fields. MA in a quantitative field Hands-on dbt project experience (models, tests, macros, CI/CD via GitLab) and familiarity with analytics engineering best practices (semantic layer design, gold-table modeling, data quality/QA frameworks). Experience designing or contributing to agentic/AI-assisted reporting tools (e.g., data contracts for LLM-driven report or recommendation generation, prompt design, retrieval pipelines). Experience with Git-based version control and CI/CD for analytics code (GitLab CI/CD or similar).

Power the Future with us! At SolarEdge (NASDAQ: SEDG), we're a global leader in smart energy technology, with over 3,000 employees, offices in 30 countries, and millions of installations worldwide. Our innovative solutions include solar inverters, battery storage, backup systems, EV charging, and AI-based energy management. We're committed to making clean, green energy the primary power source for homes, businesses, and beyond. With the growing demand for electricity, the need for smart, clean energy sources is constantly rising. SolarEdge offers amazing opportunities to develop your skills in a multidisciplinary environment, covering everything from research and development to production and customer supply. Work with talented colleagues, tackle exciting challenges, and help create a sustainable future in an industry that's always evolving and innovating. Join us and be part of a company that values creativity, agility, and impactful work. As a Sales Data Analyst at SolarEdge, you will support our sales team by compiling and analyzing sales data, providing valuable feedback and actionable insights to guide sales activities. You will champion data collection and present reports and conclusions to the management team. This role requires a strong understanding of our products and business processes, technical abilities, and a high level of accuracy. It offers a unique opportunity to gain hands-on experience in sales analysis and contribute to the success of our company. Key Responsibilities: Compile, analyze, and report sales data. Drive data collection and data cleansing activities, ensuring data integrity and accuracy. Monitor and analyze sales performance, customers behavior, determine sales potential, and issue recommendations. Provide actionable insights to the sales team and stakeholders. Prepare and present reports on data trends and sales performance. Develop and maintain BI dashboards and databases to visualize sales data and trends. Lead IS automation solutions for managing sales data. Collaborate with other departments to understand data needs. Provide administrative support to the sales team as needed. Requirements: BSc in Industrial Engineering, Statistics, Mathematics, Economics, Accounting (Economic Advisory Big4 - advantage) or equivalent from a recognized university – a must. At least 2 years’ experience in data / business analytics roles. Strong research, data analysis and technical skills. High level of accuracy and attention to details. Detail-oriented, self-starter, with the ability to manage multiple tasks in a fast-paced business environment. Proficient in written and verbal English communication – a must. Proficiency in Microsoft Office, with strong proficiency in Excel – a must. Experience working with BI tools. Experience working with SQL – advantage. Ability to work independently and with cross-functional teams. SolarEdge recognizes its talented and diverse workforce as a key competitive advantage. Our business success is a reflection of the quality and skill of our people. SolarEdge is committed to seeking out and retaining the finest human talent to ensure top business growth and performance.

  • Strong research, data analysis and technical skills

  • Proficient in written and verbal English communication must
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office, with strong proficiency in Excel must
  • Experience working with BI tools
  • Experience working with SQL plus
  • Ability to work independently and with cross-functional teams

We're looking for a Product Data Analyst to help us find the opportunities hiding in our data and turn them into real product improvements. You'll be part of the Analytics team, embedded in product decisions from the research stage to final recommendation. These aren't buzzwords, they're how we actually work. Our AI-first approach isn't just a tagline either. We're building the future of insurance with AI at the center, and we need people who are genuinely excited to learn and grow alongside these tools. IN THIS ROLE YOU’LL: - Collaborate with Analytics, Product, and Data teams to sharpen business decisions. - Initiate analyses and generate reports for feature tracking, experiments, and product health monitoring - Design A/B tests across our flows and processes to build better products - Analyze data using Snowflake, Python, and other platforms - Engage with AI agents as a core part of your work — whether that's building them, evaluating their behavior, or digging into the data to understand where and why they fall short - Present key findings to stakeholders across the company, turning data into clear, actionable direction - Map new data domains and identify signals that push our product forward WHAT YOU’LL NEED: - 3+ years of experience as a data, product, or business analyst, ideally at a fast-growing consumer company - A degree in Industrial Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics, or a related field - Strong SQL skills and hands-on experience with BI tools (Looker, Tableau, Mixpanel, or similar) - Proven ability to work with and build AI-powered tools — you know your way around the technology, not just the outputs - Familiarity with A/B testing best practices and comfort working with complex datasets - The ability to work fluidly across product managers, data engineers, and data scientists, and to communicate technical findings clearly in English - Ready to work in an office environment most days of the week

Nift is at a pivotal stage of growth. We are disrupting performance marketing by delivering millions of new customers to brands every month, and we have the data to prove it—now we need the insight to guide it. • We are looking for a Data Analyst to serve as the analytical bridge between our marketplace economics and daily business operations. This is not a "ticket-pulling" role; this is a strategic partnership role. You will wear two hats: acting as the dedicated, day-to-day data partner for our Account Managers, and operating as a proactive business intelligence engine to uncover where our next growth opportunities lie. • You will be the person with your ear to the ground, taking large-scale marketplace data and turning it into simple, meaningful actions that shape our product and business decisions. If you are an AI-native problem solver who loves automating the "boring" work to focus on high-impact strategy, we want to talk to you. • What You'll Do • Be the Business Bridge : Act as the primary data point-of-contact for Account Managers. You’ll help them diagnose complex performance issues, explain why things are happening in the data, and suggest clear, actionable next steps. • Proactive Business Intelligence : Look beyond the dashboard. Identify patterns in supply, demand, and brand performance. Job description

Saved source text; completeness has not been independently verified.

THE ROLE We are looking for a Data Analyst with 2-4 years of experience who is curious, analytical, and comfortable working with imperfect or unfamiliar data. This role is focused on understanding data deeply and turning it into meaningful insights. You will explore complex datasets, investigate the drivers behind changes in key metrics, and help stakeholders make better decisions across security operations, risk, compliance, PMO, and leadership. What You'll Do Analyze large, complex datasets to identify patterns, anomalies, and root causes, and turn them into actionable insights. Investigate changes in key metrics, form hypotheses, and run structured deep-dives to identify underlying drivers. Segment and compare data across dimensions (distributions, percentiles, baselines) to uncover meaningful differences and outliers. Research and assess new data sources and APIs from an analytical perspective: what is available, its quality and limitations, and the analytical value it could unlock. Use SQL to extract, join, and analyze data from multiple sources. Use Python (e.g., pandas) for exploratory analysis, data manipulation, and automating recurring analyses. Help define and refine KPIs and metrics together with stakeholders, contributing analytical input alongside the BI team's dashboard work. Apply the same analytical rigor to both cybersecurity risk metrics and operational/PMO KPIs (e.g., program delivery, resourcing, process efficiency). Use AI-assisted tools to speed up exploratory analysis, coding, and documentation, while validating and owning the resulting outputs. Identify data-quality issues and inconsistencies that may affect analysis, and work with the relevant teams to resolve them. Create lightweight visualizations and analytical outputs to communicate findings clearly. Present insights, conclusions, and recommendations to technical and non-technical stakeholders. Requirements Must have: 2-4 years of professional experience as a Data Analyst or in a similar hands-on analytical role. Strong SQL skills: joins, CTEs, window functions, aggregations, working across multiple data sources. Hands-on Python experience for data analysis, including libraries such as pandas (e.g., building repeatable analysis notebooks or automating a recurring report). Strong exploratory data analysis skills and comfort working with unfamiliar or messy datasets. Ability to identify trends, anomalies, and outliers, and to investigate the drivers behind changes in metrics through root-cause analysis. Strong attention to data quality and the discipline to validate findings before drawing conclusions. Ability to turn ambiguous business questions into structured analytical approaches. Clear communicator, comfortable presenting findings and recommendations to non-technical audiences. Strong written and verbal English. Security domain - strong advantage Experience working in a CISO, SOC, GRC, cybersecurity, or security operations environment. Familiarity with security metrics such as vulnerability management, incident response, access management, risk, or compliance KPIs. Experience analyzing data from security tools such as SIEM, EDR, IAM, vulnerability management, or ticketing platforms. Knowledge of frameworks such as ISO 27001, NIST CSF, or SOC 2. Nice to have Familiarity with statistical methods used in exploratory analysis and anomaly detection. Experience with Tableau, Power BI, or another BI/visualization platform. Experience with cloud platforms such as Azure, AWS, or GCP. Familiarity with data transformation concepts or tools such as dbt. Comfort using AI/LLM-based tools to accelerate analysis, coding, or documentation. Benefits & Perks Competitive compensation Career growth and learning opportunities Flexibility and ownership Collaborative and innovative culture Opportunity to work on impactful AI projects International environment and talented teams What's It Like To Work At Nebius Fast moving - Bold thinking - Constant growth - Meaningful impact - Trust and real ownership - Opportunity to shape the future of AI Equal Opportunity Statement Nebius is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse workplace and to providing equal employment opportunities in all aspects of employment. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, ancestry, age, disability, genetic information, marital status, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. Applicants must be authorized to work in the country in which they apply and will be required to provide proof of employment eligibility as a condition of hire. If you need accommodations during the application process, please let us know.

Job description

Saved source text; completeness has not been independently verified.

About The Role We're looking for a Senior Product Analyst to drive product decisions with data. You'll research how developers and companies discover, adopt and get value from Tavily and find the drivers behind them . You'll work as a thought partner to Product, R&D and leadership and shape what we build next and why. This is a senior, high-ownership role. You take a question from start to finish: you frame the problem, build the data you need, run the analysis or model, and come back with a clear recommendation. You are expected to understand the need and show people results they didn't even knew they wanted or needed and be an integrational part in decision making. You'll work closely with the analysts on the team and with Product, Engineering, Growth and GTM. What You'll Do Own product analytics end-to-end: define, instrument and measure the product funnel, from first API call through activation, feature adoption, retention and conversion to paid. Drive product decisions: work with PMs and R&D leads to set success metrics, size opportunities, prioritize the roadmap, and measure the impact of what we ship. Uncover the drivers behind top-level KPIs: which behaviors, use cases, endpoints and product experiences predict activation, retention and expansion. Design, run and evaluate experiments (A/B tests, onboarding flows, pricing and packaging changes) and apply advanced statistical models when needed. Build the data you need: model raw product, usage and billing data into trusted, reusable datasets with SQL, dbt and Python and more. Apply predictive and statistical modeling (segmentation, propensity, forecasting, classification and clustering) where it sharpens product decisions. Proactively monitor key product metrics, investigate trends and anomalies, and surface insights stakeholders can act on. Set the standard for how we measure product success: metric definitions, a shared source of truth and analytical rigor across teams. What We're Looking For 5+ years of experience as a Product Analyst, Data Analyst or Data Scientist, including at least 2 years in a product-facing role. 2+ years in a SaaS or tech product company, with deep understanding of funnels, cohorts, engagement, retention and monetization. A proven record of driving product decisions through data: you've shaped roadmaps, launches or strategy, not just reported on them. Comfort working with large, messy, event-level datasets. Strong hands-on experience using Python for data analysis, experimentation and data modeling in a production environment. Strong statistical foundations. Demonstrated ability to influence business strategy through data and drive alignment across cross-functional stakeholders, including executive leadership. Strong communication: you can turn complex analysis into a clear, compelling story and a concrete recommendation. Experience with modern data tooling (Snowflake/BigQuery, dbt, Airflow, and BI tools like Omni/Looker/Tableau). BSc in Statistics / Math / CS / Industrial Engineering or equivalent. Nice to Have Experience at an API-first, developer-focused or PLG company. Hands-on experience building and deploying ML models. Familiarity with LLMs / AI tooling, and using AI agents to speed up your own analytical work. Evidence that you build things on your own: a GitHub profile, portfolio, side projects or publications. MSc in Statistics / Math / CS or equivalent. Description: Join Enlight and help shape the future of clean energy. • Enlight is a leading global renewable energy company, developing, building, owning and operating large-scale solar, wind and energy storage projects across the U.S., Europe and MENA. As one of the fastest-growing renewable platforms, we combine entrepreneurial spirit with the scale, expertise and ambition to deliver projects that make a real impact on the global energy transition. • We're growing - and looking for talented people to join us on the journey. • The Business Performance & Planning Analyst serves as a central function within the Project Execution division headquarters, responsible for analysis, control and reporting across the portfolio of projects under execution — solar PV, energy storage, wind and related infrastructure. • The role operates horizontally across the division's departments — construction, engineering, procurement and asset management, and owns the division's models, reports and BI systems. Its primary objective is to provide division management with a single, unified, data-driven picture that supports informed decision-making and delivery against project milestones. The position combines analytical, control, and cross-functional responsibilities, requiring the ability to work independently while driving alignment across a wide range of stakeholders without direct authority. • Responsibilities: • Data, Reporting & BI — Own the division's BI and reporting systems: monitor, control and develop them while ensuring data accuracy, consistency and timeliness; produce periodic reports, dashboards and tracking of KPIs defined from time to time. • Business Modeling & Analysis — Build and maintain analytical and financial models for the division's projects — budget, cash flow, quantities, schedules and scenarios - including version control and documentation, and translate data into management insights and actionable recommendations. • Performance Control & Trend Identification — Collect and analyze cross-portfolio data, perform plan-versus-actual gap analysis, and identify trends, risks and deviations at an early stage. • Scheduling & Project Control — Support, monitor and control project schedules from early planning through construction, commissioning and handover; track project and portfolio progress, perform critical path analysis and monitor percentage of completion. • Cross-Functional Coordination — Act as a key integrator within the division headquarters: coordinate inputs across engineering, procurement, construction and subcontractors to produce a single, up-to-date status picture; consolidate topics for cross-division forums; and drive solutions across inter-company and inter-departmental interfaces. • Process Excellence & Continuous Improvement — Lead improvement initiatives within the division and participate in those led by others; develop and embed procedures, tools and best practices; drive standardization of planning, reporting and control processes across departments; and capture and implement lessons learned. • Requirements: • Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Industrial Engineering and Management, Business Administration, Economics, Engineering, or a related field - required. • 4–6 years of experience in analysis, planning and control, project controls, coordination or operations - required. • Advanced proficiency in Excel, including building and maintaining complex models, and in PowerPoint, with a proven ability to build executive-level presentations, Power BI, MS Project - required. • Strong analytical skills with the ability to translate data into insights and actionable recommendations - required. • Proven ability to operate in a matrix environment with multiple stakeholders at all levels, without direct authority - required. • Highly organized, accurate and detail-oriented, with the ability to manage multiple tasks in parallel in a dynamic environment - required. • Fluency in English, spoken and written - required. • Experience building reports, dashboards and BI tools - required • Experience in a cross-functional corporate role and in preparing materials for management and the board - an advantage. • Familiarity with budget control processes and finance interfaces - an advantage. • Experience in construction, infrastructure or renewable energy projects (solar, storage) and in working with EPC contractors - a significant advantage. •

ABOUT SEATPICK SeatPick is a profitable, fast-growing ticket comparison platform for live events. We help fans find the best tickets to sports, concerts and festivals by comparing listings from dozens of trusted resale sites in one place. More than 30 million fans use SeatPick every year, in 195 countries. We are a product-first, AI-first B2C company. THE ROLE This is our first data hire. We hold a deep dataset: millions of events and listings from dozens of marketplaces, prices that move all day, and every search, click and booking our fans make. Almost none of it is modelled today. You will build our data foundation from zero and own it end to end, working closely with Marketing, Product, Engineering and Commercial. WHAT YOU'LL DO - Choose the data stack (warehouse, ingestion, transformation, BI) and explain the choices. - Build and own pipelines and data models for marketplace, pricing, customer and marketing data. - Create a single source of truth, with clear metric definitions and documentation. - Turn business questions into reliable answers, with dashboards and KPIs that teams use to make decisions. - Enable reliable measurement of funnel performance, CAC, ROAS, LTV and cohorts. - Set data quality and monitoring standards, and find breakage before stakeholders do. - Work with Product and Engineering to capture the right events. - Use AI and agentic tools where they add value, so one person can cover the work of a team. WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR - 6+ years in BI development, analytics engineering or data engineering. - Hands-on experience building data pipelines and data models, not only dashboards. - Expert SQL and working knowledge of Python. - Experience with a cloud warehouse (BigQuery, Snowflake or Redshift) and dbt or similar. - Strong experience with BI tools (Looker, Tableau, Power BI or similar) and building a reporting layer people trust. - Experience with B2C data: funnels, marketing, user behavior and cohorts. - Comfortable as the first and only data person: you decide, build and own the outcome. - Credible with business stakeholders: you scope, push back and reframe the question. ADVANTAGES - Background in a B2C marketplace, e-commerce, travel, ticketing or gaming company. - Experience with orchestration tools (Airflow, Dagster). - Experience connecting acquisition platforms (Google, Meta) with first-party data. - Experience as a first data hire or in a small data team. WHY SEATPICK - Profitable and growing: decisions made on merit, not runway. - Real ownership and autonomy in a small, fast team. - Work around what people love: sports, music and live events worldwide. - You set the architecture, the tools and the standards. - Interesting data: live inventory, dynamic pricing and demand that changes by the hour.

  • Strong experience with BI tools (Looker, Tableau, Power BI or similar) and building a reporting layer people trust
  • Experience with B2C data: funnels, marketing, user behavior and cohorts

  • Credible with business stakeholders: you scope, push back and reframe the question

  • Experience connecting acquisition platforms (Google, Meta) with first-party data plus

Our platform helps the most ambitious businesses deliver effortless digital experiences, at scale. If you want to do career-defining work, you’ve come to the right place. With 20 offices across six continents and London as our HQ, we’re shaping the future of fintech – and we’re just getting started. About the role As we scale and evolve our fully automated fraud prevention strategies, we are seeking a Senior Data Analyst to join our growing Fraud Analytics team. We operate in a data-rich, fast-paced environment, processing billions of data points annually, and play a critical role in safeguarding large enterprises from fraud. In this role, you will work at the intersection of data analysis, fraud strategy, and automation, collaborating closely with engineering, data science, and commercial teams to develop scalable fraud detection solutions. If you are highly motivated, data-driven, and thrive in a fast-moving environment - you belong with us. Job description

Saved source text; completeness has not been independently verified.

ABOUT BRANDLIGHT Brandlight is the leading enterprise AI visibility platform, built to help the world’s leading brands understand, manage, and optimize how they appear across AI-driven search, commerce, and advertising. As AI rapidly becomes a trillion-dollar marketing and distribution channel, Brandlight is defining the systems that decide how brands are surfaced, trusted, and chosen. Join our team and help build the next generation of tools shaping the future of brand management in an AI-first world. ABOUT THE ROLE We’re looking for a Data Analyst who combines analytical rigor, strong business judgment, and the ability to turn complex data into clear, actionable insights. This role spans three core areas: marketing analytics for our clients, product analytics for Brandlight, and modeling consumer behavior in AI chats using panel data. You’ll help clients understand marketing effectiveness through attribution, marketing mix modeling, and incrementally analysis. Internally, you’ll analyze product clickstream data to understand how customers use Brandlight and identify opportunities to improve adoption, engagement, and retention. Alongside this, you’ll analyze panel and conversational data to understand how people discover brands, explore options, and progress through decision-making journeys in AI chats. You’ll own analytical projects end to end from defining the question and preparing the data to developing analytical models, validating findings, and influencing decisions. This is a hands-on role for someone who can move between business questions, event-level data, and statistical analysis and take ownership before every requirement has been defined. ℹ️ How the tags on this board are computed

Everything is extracted deterministically from the posting text — a fixed keyword lexicon and header rules, no AI guessing. A tag can be missing simply because the posting never stated it; postings without a captured description show no tags at all.

Skills are matched from a curated 98-term lexicon and grouped into non-overlapping clusters: SQL & Databases, ETL & Infrastructure, Coding, ML & Statistics, Visualization & BI, Other. Hover any tag for its meaning.

MUST / PLUS badges mirror the posting’s own wording (“a must”, “an advantage”, חובה / יתרון) — absence of a badge means the posting didn’t mark that line. Years is the experience figure stated nearest to “experience”. Degree shows the level and fields asked for; “plus” means the posting itself calls the degree an advantage.

Day-to-day groups classify the responsibilities section: Instrument & manage tracking (Setting up event tracking, taxonomies and instrumentation) · Assure data quality (Validation, anomaly detection, alerting — keeping the data trustworthy) · Run experiments & build models (A/B tests, statistical models and forecasts) · Define metrics & KPIs (Owning metric definitions — the single source of truth for KPIs) · Build pipelines & data models (ETL, warehouse models and analytical infrastructure) · Build dashboards & track performance (Dashboards, recurring reports and performance tracking) · Analyze & recommend (Deep dives and analysis that end in insights and recommendations) · Partner & present (Working with business teams — gathering needs, presenting findings). A chip appears only when a group matches multiple responsibility bullets — it marks an emphasis of the role, not a passing mention — and chips are ordered by how dominant each theme is.

🤖 AI usage classifies what the analyst is expected to do with AI, judged from the words around each AI mention: AI for efficiency (Expected to use AI tools (Copilot, ChatGPT, Cursor…) to work faster) · AI for automation (Using AI to automate processes and workflows) · Building with AI (Building AI/LLM-powered features, models or data products) · AI (unspecified) (AI mentioned without a specific use identified). WHERE the mention sits matters: in the requirements section it is prior experience you must bring; in the responsibilities it is part of the job — learnable, not a bar to entry. The dashboard and chips keep the two apart. Mentions of the company’s own AI product (“analyze our AI agents”) are deliberately NOT counted — that is product analysis, not AI usage.

Soft skills (dotted chips) are tagged from the requirements section only — the person the posting describes, separate from the toolbox: communication, ownership, business acumen, curiosity, and so on. Hover any chip for its meaning.

reposted marks a posting whose date was bumped 3+ days after this board first saw it, with the original date in the card.
